claims: Maintain continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring with arterial line and ST segment monitoring, keeping SpO2 desaturation limit at 88% and alarms active.
Continue supplemental oxygen at 3 L/min via nasal cannula, titrating to maintain SpO2 above 92%.
Reassess pain level and administer as-needed analgesia per ordered regimen (morphine, oxycodone, acetaminophen) for moderate-to-severe pain.
Implement fall precautions given history of falls within 3 months and bed rest status, including bed alarm and assistance with all transfers.
Perform pressure injury prevention measures (repositioning, skin assessment) given Braden activity score of bedfast.
Monitor temperature and continue as-needed acetaminophen for fever; current temperature 98.5°F.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units as ordered.
Maintain IV access and continue isotonic sodium chloride infusion as ordered.
Monitor complete blood count and electrolytes (WBC 14.2, hemoglobin 11.6, electrolytes within normal limits) and repeat as clinically indicated.
Assess and manage nausea with as-needed ondansetron and promethazine per ordered regimen.
